fact: Burrow Warden Jadger is a three-foot-tall ghost who materializes in the catacombs.
source_quote: Burrow Warden Jadger, a three-foot-tall ghost, materializes in the catacombs after Pelek's departure.
subject: Burrow Warden Jadger

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger identifies his pronouns as he/him.
source_quote: Jadger identifies his pronouns as he/him.
subject: Burrow Warden Jadger

fact: Zalthir is not carrying any weapons.
source_quote: the Dragonborn is not carrying any weapons
subject: Zalthir

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger pays particular attention to Zalthir because the Dragonborn is unarmed.
source_quote: Jadger pays particular attention to Zalthir because the Dragonborn is not carrying any weapons.
subject: Burrow Warden Jadger

fact: Zalthir is a monk.
source_quote: When Zalthir explains that he is a monk
subject: Zalthir

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger declares that Zalthir would be an excellent asset upon learning he is a monk.
source_quote: Ah, then you would be an excellent asset
subject: Jadger on Zalthir

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger floats upward to make himself more imposing.
source_quote: Jadger floats upward to make himself more imposing
subject: Jadger levitates

fact: The Burrow Wardens were the first and last line of defense of Blingdenstone.
source_quote: the Burrow Wardens were “the first and last line of defense of Blingdenstone.”
subject: Burrow Wardens

fact: Most of the honored protectors of the Burrow Wardens died during the Drow invasion.
source_quote: Most of the honored protectors died during the Drow invasion
subject: Burrow Wardens casualties

fact: The remaining Burrow Wardens perished while protecting their people during the flight from Blingdenstone.
source_quote: the remainder perished while protecting their people during the flight from Blingdenstone
subject: Burrow Wardens casualties

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger defended Blingdenstone against the Drow, oozes, and other Underdark creatures.
source_quote: Jadger says that he defended Blingdenstone against the Drow, oozes, and a long list of other Underdark creatures.
subject: Burrow Warden Jadger

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger has taken it upon himself to establish a new group of Burrow Wardens since the deep gnomes recaptured Blingdenstone.
source_quote: he has taken it upon himself to establish a new group of Burrow Wardens
subject: New Burrow Wardens

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger is proud of several young gnomes he has been training in secret.
source_quote: He is proud of several young gnomes whom he has been training in secret.
subject: Young gnomes

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger describes himself as an expert on the Underdark and its denizens, and on methods for fighting them.
source_quote: Jadger describes himself as an expert on the Underdark and its denizens, as well as on methods for fighting them.
subject: Burrow Warden Jadger

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger offers to answer one question for every ghost the party puts to rest within the community.
source_quote: He offers to answer one question for every ghost the party puts to rest within the community.
subject: Ghost quest deal

fact: Pelek's interment counts as the first completed task, granting the party one question credit.
source_quote: Pelek's interment counts as the first completed task, giving the party one answer that it may claim immediately or save for later.
subject: Question credit

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger mentions there are two more ghosts he would like the party to deal with for two additional question answers.
source_quote: there are two more ghosts he would like the party to deal with if they want two additional questions answered.
subject: Remaining ghosts

fact: Gyrgum avoids asking how many mysteries there are to avoid being tricked.
source_quote: Gyrgum avoids asking how many mysteries there are because “this feels like a genie situation where you can get fooled into asking your question before you know you're asking your question.”
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The party debates whether the phrase 'I wish we knew' counts as a question for the purpose of the deal.
source_quote: When someone says, “I wish we knew,” the party debates whether a wish counts as a question.
subject: Wish debate

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger rejects being compared to a genie.
source_quote: I'm not some trivial genie. I am Burrow Warden Jadger.
subject: Burrow Warden Jadger

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger claims to know things about the Underdark that other people have forgotten.
source_quote: I know things about the Underdark that other people have forgotten were things.
subject: Burrow Warden Jadger

fact: Chief Dorbo knows how to leave the Underdark.
source_quote: Chief Dorbo and Senni know how to leave the Underdark and that the route is well known.
subject: Chief Dorbo

fact: Senni knows how to leave the Underdark.
source_quote: Chief Dorbo and Senni know how to leave the Underdark and that the route is well known.
subject: Senni

fact: The party decides to use its question on how best to deal with the oozes.
source_quote: the party decides to ask how best to deal with the oozes.
subject: Question selection

fact: Ordinary oozes are solitary and do not bother others unless bothered.
source_quote: They kind of live in their corner, and as long as you don't bother them, they don't bother you.
subject: Oozes

fact: A mass of oozes acting together is unusual and suggests an external source providing direction or orders.
source_quote: A mass of oozes acting together is therefore highly unusual and suggests that something is providing direction, orders, or a mission.
subject: Ooze coordination

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger recommends sending a carefully organized strike force to find whatever caused the ooze behavior.
source_quote: His initial recommendation is to send a carefully organized strike force into the affected area and look for whatever “made no sense.”
subject: Burrow Warden Jadger

fact: Zalthir mentions that the party suspects a connection to Juiblex regarding the oozes.
source_quote: Zalthir mentions that the party suspects a connection to Juiblex.
subject: Zalthir

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger treats the mention of Juiblex as a clarification and asks Zalthir to demonstrate a monk technique for the young gnomes.
source_quote: Jadger treats this as a clarification rather than an entirely separate question, but asks Zalthir to demonstrate a monk technique that could be taught to the young gnomes.
subject: Jadger's condition

fact: Zalthir agrees and performs a monk technique for Burrow Warden Jadger.
source_quote: Zalthir agrees and performs the technique.
subject: Zalthir demonstrates technique

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger tries moving his fists in imitation of Zalthir, but performs the movements incorrectly.
source_quote: Jadger is impressed and tries moving his own fists in imitation, though he performs the movements incorrectly while Zalthir resists correcting him immediately.
subject: Jadger imitates

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger tells a rambling demon story before returning to the point.
source_quote: Jadger launches into a rambling demon story likened to Grandpa Simpson's “onion tied to my belt” monologue before returning to the point.
subject: Burrow Warden Jadger

fact: Devils make deals, granting people ungodly power and enjoying their personal corruption and destruction.
source_quote: Devils make deals,” granting people ungodly power and enjoying their personal corruption and destruction.
subject: Devils

fact: Demons find souls, imbue them with terrifying power, and enjoy watching them destroy everything around them.
source_quote: Demons instead find “poor benighted souls,” imbue them with terrifying power, and enjoy watching them destroy everything around them.
subject: Demons

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger summarizes the distinction between devils (personal corruption) and demons (maximum carnage).
source_quote: With devils, it's a very personal corruption of the souls. With demons, it's about causing maximum carnage and destruction.
subject: Burrow Warden Jadger

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger advises the party to look for someone or something motivating the oozes.
source_quote: If I were you, I would go look for someone or something that is motivating those oozes.
subject: Burrow Warden Jadger

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger corrects the party's assumption that Juiblex is directly controlling the oozes.
source_quote: No, no, no, that's not what I said.
subject: Burrow Warden Jadger

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger's theory is that Juiblex has granted power to a proxy or intermediate agent directing the oozes.
source_quote: His actual theory is that Juiblex has granted power to a proxy or intermediate agent who is directing the oozes.
subject: Juiblex's proxy

fact: The party jokes that the demon has a “consigliere” and that they will “go to the mattresses.”
source_quote: The party reduces the theory to finding and killing whoever has been granted the power, joking that the demon has a “consigliere” and that they will “go to the mattresses.”
subject: Consigliere joke

fact: Burrow Warden Jadger suggests the party consult a young gnome under his mentorship once they have gathered information.
source_quote: Jadger suggests that, once the party has gathered information, it should consult a young gnome under his mentorship who will soon become leader of the new Burrow Wardens.
subject: Burrow Warden Jadger

fact: The trainee gnome is too young for the present mission but may have useful insights after the party discovers more about the infestation.
source_quote: The trainee is too young for the present mission but may have useful insights after the party discovers more about the infestation.
subject: Trainee gnome
